description: Labeled retrieval check for the semantic index. Each query is a plain-language description written from the stored text of the expected record(s); every expected record carries an `evidence` phrase that must occur in the text the index embeds (scripts/semantic/evaluate.py verify-labels fails otherwise). The queries paraphrase the text instead of quoting its headings. A query is a hit when any expected record is among the top-k records.
